definitions.explanation: A room in a university or educational institution designed for lectures. Typically has tiered seating arranged for listening to a speaker.

examples.japanese: {講義室|こうぎしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: To head to the lecture room.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{講義室|こうぎしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三百人|さんびゃくにん}⟦{収容|しゅうよう}→収容：11800_shuuyou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This lecture hall can accommodate three hundred people.

examples.japanese: {講義室|こうぎしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: If you sit in the front of the lecture room, you can hear the professor better.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{講義|こうぎ}→講義：01579_kougi⟧ (lecture) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). Primarily used in university settings for rooms designed for lectures, typically with tiered seating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|だい}{講義室|こうぎしつ}: large lecture hall
- {講義室|こうぎしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: room change for a lecture
- {講義室|こうぎしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the lecture room

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR ROOMS:
- ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧: classroom (general, any level — schools and universities)
- {講義室|こうぎしつ}: lecture room (university-specific, larger, for lectures)
- ⟦{講堂|こうどう}→講堂：01586_koudou⟧: auditorium (even larger, for events and ceremonies)
- {演習室|えんしゅうしつ}: seminar room (smaller, for discussion-based classes)

THE ～{室|しつ} SUFFIX:
Common in room names: ⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧ (meeting room), ⟦{研究室|けんきゅうしつ}→研究室：01397_kenkyuushitsu⟧ (research lab/office), ⟦{待合室|まちあいしつ}→待合室：07373_machiaishitsu⟧ (waiting room).
